Hi all,

Thanks for the details, Connor and Sara. Short answer: policy defaults to PO-required for supplier invoices. For small pilots we can, on a case-by-case basis, approve a temporary "invoice-only" onboarding track with controls.

Options and required evidence:

1) Standard route (PO required) — timeline: 7–10 business days to create vendor record and issue PO after intake is complete. Requirements: supplier intake form, EU entity registration docs, bank details (IBAN), W-9/W-8 equivalent, and accounting code mapping.

2) Temporary invoice-only pilot (exception) — timeline: 2–4 business days for procurement + finance triage if the intake packet is complete. Conditions:
  - Pilot invoices must be schedulable monthly and under €2,500 per invoice
  - Cumulus must provide SOC2 summary (or equivalent) and evidence of data handling minimization for the trial
  - Finance will require pre-approval for each invoice (email approval chain) and retention of invoice PDFs in the vendor record
  - Exception period limited to 90 days (one renewal allowed, requires renewed sign-off)

Please attach the supplier-intake-form (our template) and the SOC2 summary (you already referenced that). Once we have those, procurement will triage and — if everything checks out — we can grant the temporary invoice-only path for the pilot. Attaching the supplier-intake-form template here for convenience.

Attachments referenced: supplier-intake-form.pdf

Connor — if you want, I can escalate to Laura for pre-approval of the 90-day exception now; otherwise, I'll triage and come back with a decision within one business day.

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Procurement Operations — Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

Hi Priyom, Connor —

Thanks for the clear options. Attached: our SOC2 summary and a filled copy of the supplier-intake-form (see brief answers on pp.2–3). We are an EU-registered SAS (FR) and invoices will come from our paris-invoicing@cumulusai.com address.

A few clarifications / asks:
- We prefer the temporary invoice-only path for speed.
- Is the email approval for each invoice acceptable? We can add a PDF cover note referencing the Redwood opportunity id (DEAL-8732) to the invoice to speed matching.
- We may need the 90-day window extended by another 60 days if the pilot extends into a limited production stage; would that be subject to a different SLA or require a PO?

Attachments (sent): cumulus-soc2-summary.pdf, supplier-intake-form.pdf

Best,
Sara
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sara Diaz <sara@cumulusai.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:38:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup for EU pilot — invoices and PO question

Sara / Connor / Priyom —

I've reviewed the intake packet and the SOC2 summary. Finance will approve a temporary invoice-only onboarding exception for Cumulus AI's 3-month PoC under these controls:

- Exception window: 90 days from first invoice receipt (starts when the first invoice is posted in our AP tracker). No automatic extension — any extension beyond 90 days requires Finance + Procurement approval and a risk re-evaluation.
- Invoices must: include DEAL-8732 on the invoice PDF, be sent from paris-invoicing@cumulusai.com, and be below €2,500 each.
- Prior to payment, Connor must reply-all to the invoice email with explicit approval language ("Approve payment for invoice INV-12345 for DEAL-8732") — this will be retained in the vendor record as the approval chain.
- Procurement will create a limited vendor record (temp_vendor_cumulus-fr) to track evidence; all intake docs will be stored in that record.

Priyom — please create the temp vendor record and confirm the vendor email to which Redwood should direct PO (if we later move to PO). Also confirm when AP should expect the first invoice to plan cashflow.

Sara — thanks for being responsive. Connor, please confirm you accept the approval step above so Procurement/Finance can mark the exception active.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
